s1.syndrome_frame: A cardiac abnormality with a systolic murmur and abnormal ECG findings in a young pregnant woman
salient_findings: Systolic murmur in the left upper parasternal region
Complete right bundle-branch block with normal PR interval on ECG
Dilated right atrium and right ventricle on echocardiography
key_facts: 29-year-old primigravida woman
No history of dyspnea, chest pain, palpitation, or lower limb swelling
Vital parameters within normal limits
Systolic murmur in the left upper parasternal region
Normal sinus rhythm with heart rate of 70 beats/min on ECG
Complete right bundle-branch block with normal PR interval on ECG
Fragmented QRS with a notch on the R wave in inferior leads on ECG
No significant ST-T segment changes on ECG
Dilated right atrium and right ventricle on echocardiography
Large 21-mm defect with left-to-right shunt on echocardiography
Normal cardiac output on right-sided heart catheterization
Step-up in oxygenation from superior vena cava to right atrium
Pulmonary vascular resistance: 1.8 Wood units
